observation: At frame 40, the render does not show a clear liquid jet/spray or pooled puddle despite a liquid domain and an inflow/geometry flow being set up and baked.
expected_behavior: Visible sideways pressurized spray from burst fitting, impact splash/rivulets on cabinet wall, and a shallow pooled puddle with early drip over front lip by frame 40.
actual_behavior: Little to no visible liquid: no distinct spray cone/airborne droplets, no clear puddle sheen/meniscus, and no visible drips; scene reads mostly as static cabinet/props.
recommended_fix: Increase environment/background strength and add stronger surface normal detail so clear water becomes readable; if allowed in future API spec, use use_plane_init=True for inflow and increase sampling_substeps to prevent discretized jet. Also verify generated liquid mesh/particles are not hidden and have the water material.
analysis_notes: The sim produced VDB caches, but the beauty render lacks readable liquid. Likely causes: water is optically too invisible under current lighting (Transmission=1 with weak reflections), insufficient bump/normal breakup, and/or the inflow emitter approach (thin volume without plane_init/substeps) failing to create an obvious spray. Structural rendering check: ensure the generated liquid mesh object is identified and not hidden; assign water material to it explicitly.
